market_scan.notes: Queried Optimal events for NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL. SQL fallback scanned game odds/projections and player_odds/player_projections; player props were ranked after consensus-line grouping, stale-line filters (+odds <= +1000 and EV <= +500%), win_prob >= 50%, and bet-family dedupe.
